tools.name: btc_network_metrics
tools.description: Daily Bitcoin network series computed by X PrimeFlow on its own Bitcoin full node: hash rate, difficulty, transaction count, unique addresses, coin days destroyed, NVT ratio, miner revenue in BTC and fee rates. Returns the latest values or one series with up to 365 daily points, with asOf and age.

tools.name: eth_network_metrics
tools.description: Daily Ethereum series computed by X PrimeFlow on its own execution (geth) and beacon (lighthouse) nodes: ETH burned, base fee, gas, blob fees, validators and staked ETH, stablecoin supply on L1 and ETH held in L2 bridges. Returns the latest values or one series with up to 365 daily points, with asOf

tools.name: onchain_liquidations
tools.description: Liquidations of perpetual positions on Hyperliquid and Helix (Injective) for one coin over the last 24 hours and 7 days: long and short USD totals, event counts and the largest liquidation. Each venue shows up to which time its feed has been read. Coins are those of the open liquidation summary: ETH

tools.name: hyperliquid_trader_board
tools.description: Hyperliquid traders ranked by X PrimeFlow by how copyable their trading was over the last 30 days, recomputed from raw fills: realised PnL of closed round trips, win rate against payoff, profit factor, drawdown of the PnL curve, tenure and three copyability checks. tools.name: sec_filings_insiders
tools.description: Company filings with the SEC parsed by X PrimeFlow: 8-K events and 13D/13G stakes, Form 4 insider transactions, and crypto treasury holdings reported in filings, for a tracked universe of crypto-related and large US companies. Summary views need no ticker; per-company views take a ticker.

tools.name: sec_13f_holdings
tools.description: Quarterly 13F holdings of institutional managers, matched by X PrimeFlow: biggest inflows and outflows by stock, the largest filers, holders of one stock, positions of one manager, and dataset coverage. Long positions above the reporting threshold only.

tools.name: macro_cot_m2
tools.description: CFTC Commitments of Traders for CME Bitcoin futures (weekly positions of leveraged funds, asset managers, dealers and small traders) and US M2 money supply from the Federal Reserve H.6 release, monthly and weekly.

tools.name: chain_overview
tools.description: State of the Ethereum, Gno.land, AtomOne and Provenance networks read by X PrimeFlow from its own nodes: overview, network, staking, validators, governance and other sections. Parts that were answered by a node we may not redistribute are held back and listed.

tools.name: bonynode_validator_status
tools.description: Whether the BonyNode validator is in the active set on the chains it validates, with its status as read from the chains.

tools.name: data_sources_status
tools.description: Where X PrimeFlow data comes from and how fresh each collector is, plus reference lists: indicator definitions, the coin-to-sector taxonomy and real-world-asset categories.
